about: Harish Subramanian is a technology and delivery leader with more than twenty years of experience across telecommunications, healthcare and enterprise SaaS.

At Charter Communications, he leads end-to-end delivery for a broadband device activation and provisioning platform, bringing portfolio management, product management, quality engineering and DevOps together under one delivery discipline. His current focus is AI-enabled delivery: helping engineering organizations adopt AI in a governed, tool-agnostic way, and using delivery data to make execution more predictable.

Earlier, he spent a decade in healthcare transformation with Cognizant and UST, leading platform implementations, building analytics and decision-support capabilities, and advising organizations entering new markets, after leading healthcare software delivery across Australia, New Zealand and Ireland. He also led a global Salesforce delivery portfolio at DXC Technology.
He is a certified SAFe practitioner and trainer, and holds CSPO and SAFe Advanced Scrum Master certifications. He is based in Denver, Colorado.
